title: Words to read and colour: Madd letters
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 2: At-Takathur, Al-Qari'ah, madd letters and shaddah
source: Written for quran/y2 lesson 30 (Pupil PDF worksheet: words to read and colour)
intro: Lesson 30. Read each word slowly to a grown-up, then colour the part we learned today (Madd letters). Then trace and copy.

questions.a: kallaa: two counts on the alif.

questions.q: Pupil PDF: read eight letters with alif madd (بَا تَا ثَا ...) and colour each alif. The teacher listens to today's group.
questions.a: Eight madd sounds read; alifs coloured.

questions.q: Extend: find an alif madd in Al-'Asr.
questions.a: ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ: the small alif after the seen (al-insaan).
A) baa (long). Fathah + alif: a long 'aa' for two counts.

questions.q: How many counts do we stretch a madd?
Think again: Say 'ba' and then 'baa'. What changed?
questions.a: The sound got longer: the alif stretches it for two counts.
